owner_summaries.key_concerns: Control TB.BAL.001 and FX.COV.001 are not operating effectively, leading to potential financial reporting inaccuracies and currency policy violations.

residual_risks.description: Entity-level TB balances are not zero, indicating potential misstatements in financial reports.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Implement stricter reconciliation controls and automate TB validation checks.

residual_risks.description: FX rates coverage does not meet policy requirements, exposing the organization to regulatory non-compliance and financial loss.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Enhance FX rate validation processes and conduct regular compliance audits.

residual_risks.description: Flux analysis exceptions count is high, indicating potential operational inefficiencies or errors in account management.
residual_risks.mitigation_recommendations: Investigate root causes of flux exceptions and improve account monitoring controls.
